evidence.title: Church names pastor killed by falling sign at Christian festival

occurrences.checkable_against: Fundraising page for Robert Guanco's family
occurrences.quote_span: On a fundraising page for Guanco's family, pastor Norman Ponce from Jesus the Living Water Worldwide Church, said he was a "faithful servant of God".
occurrences.speaker: Norman Ponce
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident

occurrences.checkable_against: Jesus the Living Water Church statement about Robert Guanco
occurrences.quote_span: In a statement, his church said: "Pastor Robert was a faithful servant of God, a loving husband to Isay, a devoted and caring father to Ellie, and a blessing to so many people whose lives he touched.
occurrences.speaker: Jesus the Living Water Church
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident

occurrences.checkable_against: Sarah Mullally's public statement about the Big Church Festival incident
occurrences.quote_span: Dame Sarah Mullally said: "I pray for his family, friends and loved ones as they grieve. I pray for those receiving treatment, and the healthcare workers looking after them.
occurrences.speaker: Sarah Mullally, Archbishop of Canterbury
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident

occurrences.checkable_against: Norman Ponce's fundraising-page statement
occurrences.quote_span: Ponce said Guanco was a "beloved son, cherished brother, loving husband" and "great father".
occurrences.speaker: Norman Ponce
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident

occurrences.checkable_against: Archbishop of Canterbury's public statement about the Big Church Festival incident
occurrences.quote_span: The Archbishop of Canterbury said she was "sad and shocked" to hear about the fatal incident.
occurrences.speaker: Sarah Mullally, Archbishop of Canterbury
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident

occurrences.checkable_against: Big Church Festival official website and organizational records
occurrences.quote_span: The Big Church Festival, which describes itself as the UK's biggest Christian festival, was founded in 2009.
occurrences.speaker: Big Church Festival
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident

occurrences.checkable_against: Sussex Police public appeal for information
occurrences.quote_span: Sussex Police is urging anyone with information about the incident to contact them.
occurrences.speaker: Sussex Police
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident

occurrences.checkable_against: Norman Ponce's fundraising-page statement
occurrences.quote_span: He said Guanco's family was facing an "unimaginable loss".
occurrences.speaker: Norman Ponce
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident

occurrences.checkable_against: Norman Ponce's fundraising-page statement
occurrences.quote_span: "He was also a good friend, mentor, and a blessing to so many people whose lives he touched," Ponce said.
occurrences.speaker: Norman Ponce
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident

occurrences.checkable_against: Norman Ponce's fundraising-page statement
occurrences.quote_span: "His life reflected humility, faith, love, compassion, and service. Through his ministry, kindness, prayers, and encouragement, he touched many lives."
occurrences.speaker: Norman Ponce
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident

occurrences.checkable_against: Norman Ponce's fundraising-page statement
occurrences.quote_span: "Though Pastor Robert's earthly journey has come to an end, his legacy of faith, love, service, and the lives he touched will never be forgotten," Ponce said.
occurrences.speaker: Norman Ponce
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident

occurrences.checkable_against: Sussex Police incident records and hospital admission records
occurrences.quote_span: Six other people were injured at the event by a falling sign at the Big Church Festival , near Steyning, four of whom were taken to hospital for treatment.
occurrences.speaker: BBC's own
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident

occurrences.checkable_against: Big Church Festival organizer cancellation announcement and event schedule
occurrences.quote_span: The event at Wiston Park began on Friday and was due to continue until Sunday, but a decision was made by organisers to cancel the remainder of the event after the incident.
occurrences.speaker: BBC's own
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident

occurrences.checkable_against: Jesus the Living Water Church invitation and Sovereign Harbour Community Centre event records
occurrences.quote_span: Guanco's church has invited people to come to the Sovereign Harbour Community Centre in Eastbourne on Sunday to commemorate the pastor's life and to celebrate his daughter's birthday.
occurrences.speaker: Jesus the Living Water Church
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident

occurrences.checkable_against: Norman Ponce's fundraising-page statement
occurrences.quote_span: "What was meant to be a time of worship, fellowship, and celebration became an unimaginable tragedy," he added.
occurrences.speaker: Norman Ponce
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident

occurrences.checkable_against: Sussex Police incident records and notifications to the Health and Safety Executive and local authority
occurrences.quote_span: The force said the Health and Safety Executive and local authority had also been informed about the incident.
occurrences.speaker: Sussex Police
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident

occurrences.checkable_against: Sussex Police incident records and Jesus the Living Water Church announcement
occurrences.quote_span: The man killed at a Christian festival in West Sussex on Friday has been named by his church as Robert Guanco, 41.
occurrences.speaker: Jesus the Living Water Church
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident

occurrences.checkable_against: Big Church Festival organizational records and official website
occurrences.quote_span: The Big Church Festival, which describes itself as the UK's biggest Christian festival, was founded in 2009.
occurrences.speaker: Big Church Festival and BBC's own
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident

occurrences.checkable_against: Sarah Mullally's public statement about the Big Church Festival incident
occurrences.quote_span: "And I pray too for the other festival goers, staff and event organisers as they come to terms with these tragic events."
occurrences.speaker: Sarah Mullally, Archbishop of Canterbury
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident

occurrences.checkable_against: Jesus the Living Water Church staff and membership records
occurrences.quote_span: He was a pastor at Jesus the Living Water Church in Eastbourne, East Sussex.
occurrences.speaker: BBC's own
occurrences.subject: Big Church Festival falling sign incident
